title: The stage diagram of a compatible étale injective replacement
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ any cone with point $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian étale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with transitions $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute et})$ be equipped with objectwise isomorphisms $e_{G,i}:G_i\simeq c_i^{-1}F_i$ and the canonical transition equations. There exist compatible coefficient systems $A_i,R_i$, with the same inverse-image identity and composition laws, and pulled-back functors $G_A,G_R$ on $X$ with objectwise isomorphisms $e_{A,i},e_{R,i}$ and canonical transition equations. There are maps $a_i:F_i\to A_i$ and $b_i:A_i\to R_i$ such that their short complexes are short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], and every $A_i$ is injective. There are natural transformations $\alpha:G\to G_A$, $\beta:G_A\to G_R$ with $\alpha\beta=0$ whose short complex in the functor category is short exact. For each $i$ there is a morphism from the inverse image under $c_i$ of the stage short complex to the component at $i$ of this functor-category short complex, whose first component is $e_{G,i}^{-1}$ and whose third component is $e_{R,i}^{-1}$. No colimit cocone, colimit exact sequence, limit property of $c$, quasi-compactness or affine transition hypothesis is required. An injective sheaf is an object for which every map into it extends across every monomorphism; a morphism of short complexes consists of three maps commuting with both differentials.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 21.16.5: product of direct images, its system transitions and compatible embeddings; stage cokernels and exact inverse-image transport use Tag 04JC. This is the stage-diagram portion of steps 1 and 3 of the parent node, before filtered colimits.

proof.text: Use enough injectives on the essentially small étale topoi to obtain canonical Injective.under embeddings. At i form the product, indexed by pairs (k, i to k), of lowerStar of these embeddings. Define the embedding component by transposing the coefficient transition followed by the canonical injective embedding through the upperStar/lowerStar adjunction. Transpose transitions through the upperStar/lowerStar adjunction. Direct images preserve injectives because inverse image is exact; products preserve injectivity. The identity-arrow component proves that the embedding is mono, and the adjunction unit, composition comparison and product projections prove the identity, cocycle and embedding compatibility equations. Use stagewise cokernels; exact inverse image preserves their universal properties, so compatibility induces cokernel transitions and cancellation of cokernel projections proves their system equations.

Use the cone equation to compose stage transitions with the upperStar comparison isomorphisms, giving GI and GR. Transport embeddings and quotient maps through the prescribed objectwise isomorphisms to natural transformations α and β. Their composite is zero. Exact inverse image gives short exactness at each stage; kernels and cokernels in the functor category are objectwise, hence the natural-transformation short complex is short exact. The inverse objectwise identifications give the short-complex maps s; their first and third components are the inverse comparisons by construction. This produces only the stage diagram, without taking any colimit.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_replacement_stage_diagram
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
 :
    ∃ (FR : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φR : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FR i) ⟶ FR j)
    (hidentityR : ∀ i : I, φR (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FR i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FR i))
    (hcompositionR : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φR (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φR f) ≫ φR g)
    (GR : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eGR : ∀ i : I, GR.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (FR i))
    (hGR : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), GR.map f =
      (eGR i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φR f) ≫ (eGR j).inv)
    (FI : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FI i) ⟶ FI j)
    (hidentityI : ∀ i : I, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FI i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FI i))
    (hcompositionI : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      ψ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (GI : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eGI : ∀ i : I, GI.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (FI i))
    (hGI : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), GI.map f =
      (eGI i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (ψ f) ≫ (eGI j).inv)
    (ai : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ FI i) (bi : ∀ i : I, FI i ⟶ FR i)
    (wi : ∀ i : I, ai i ≫ bi i = 0)
    (hi : ∀ i : I, (ShortComplex.mk (ai i) (bi i) (wi i)).ShortExact)
    (α : G ⟶ GI) (β : GI ⟶ GR) (w : α ≫ β = 0)
    (s : ∀ i : I,
      (ShortComplex.mk (ai i) (bi i) (wi i)).map
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))) ⟶
      (ShortComplex.mk (α.app i) (β.app i) (congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app i) w))),
      (∀ i : I, Injective (FI i)) ∧
      (ShortComplex.mk α β w).ShortExact ∧
      (∀ i : I, (s i).τ₁ = (eG i).inv) ∧
      (∀ i : I, (s i).τ₃ = (eGR i).inv)
